text_block_list.text: One day during practice, Eishin Flash suddenly stopped in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Haa, haa...! My legs feel
somewhat heavier than usual."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
At this pace,
we won't finish in time...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I need to work even harder
so we don't fall behind schedule...

"She might be exhausted from the race.
It seems necessary to review her upcoming race schedule."
